message: ピース谷村洋菓子店
Now then, what was today's special again...

name: Man
message: 「Thank you very much! We look forward to your next visit.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. I'm counting on you!」
Oh, that's Nanaka. Which means...

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「That cake shop you just came out of is actually a hidden gem」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, it's a lost cause best left unfound. At least for now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Harsh. Is it really that bad?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haven't you heard of it? 'Alexandrine'」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah! Uncle Amakawa once told me, 'You'd be better off licking sugar cubes than buying cake from that place!'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, that's the one」

name: Synn
message: 「But... the sign says 'Peace Tanimura Patisserie'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They changed the shop's name back」

name: Synn
message: 「Why go out of their way to do that? Oh, I get it! Its bad reputation spread so far that they're starting fresh!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if that's the case, instead of going back to a name like 'Peace Tanimura Patisserie,' they should've picked something way more stylish」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't remember... do you, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Remember what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've eaten sweets from that shop before, you know. Back when you came over to my house to hang out.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「An eclair stuffed to the brim with whipped cream and chocolate chips inside」

name: Synn
message: 「...At your house?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though the shape was a little lopsided」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!」
The cake Nanaka's aunt served us.
Nanaka and I, sitting side by side stuffing our faces with eclairs.
Nanaka looked so genuinely happy...

name: Synn
message: 「It was... really good」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sweet and delicious, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... that's what I said」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've had a pitiful vocabulary for describing food since way back when. Makes it hard to tell if you're actually enjoying it or not」

name: Synn
message: 「Still... that cake really was... delicious」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. I'm glad」
The sweet, rich, yet somehow refreshing taste of that generous whipped cream vividly comes back to my tongue.
The slightly bitter chocolate chips paired exquisitely with the whipped cream.

name: Synn
message: 「If I go to that shop, can I taste something that good again...」
I'll definitely go buy some someday.
Though before that, I have to figure out how to get the money.

name: Paqy
message: 「When you do, grab one for yours truly too, please」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I wish that were the case, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Really? Even though it was so delicious」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because it changed hands」

name: Synn
message: 「...So we can't get that taste anymore」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For now, anyway」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that person really that promising of a pastry chef?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why do you think that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because despite having such a bad reputation, a sweets lover like you is keeping an eye on him」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, it's not like that----」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you know. Look, as someone who remembers the previous owner's flavors, I'm obligated to keep watch over him, right」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doesn't sound like the Soba who's strict about sweets」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I mean... you think so? Still, Tanimura-san said he's turning over a new leaf and giving it his all」

name: Synn
message: 「Tanimura-san is the culprit?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. The manager himself said so, so there's no mistake」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're being soft. Your title as the 'Sweets Demon' is weeping!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not true. It's just like the loyal Nanaka we know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's not about loyalty or anything like that... The previous owner just asked me to keep an eye on things...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, Tanimura-san had a serious look in his eyes, and he's got the previous owner's blood in him, so there's no way he has bad taste」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope the old flavor comes back someday」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When it does, I'll let you know too, Synn. And then... um, well... maybe we could go eat together...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, never mind!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Take me along too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Okay!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It worked! Together... a d-date...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-Tehehe」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, who knows when that'll ever happen」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Shut up!」
